transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um, hi. Well... I guess I came in because I just feel really wound up all the time. It's... I don't know, it's like my body is always bracing for the next bad thing to happen. Even if I'm just sitting at my desk, or... trying to enjoy dance night. I just... yeah. I can't really relax.
Do you feel anxious most days, even in situations where there’s no obvious reason to be worried, like when you’re at home relaxing or spending time with family?

Um... yeah. I guess so. It just... it doesn't really stay on one thing anymore, like my condo. It just kind of jumps around. Like, I'll be sitting there and suddenly I'm worrying about whether my cousin is upset with me... or if I'm going to make a mistake on a support call at work. Or just... how I'll ever save money, or move forward with my life. I don't know. It's just always something.
Do you notice any physical symptoms, like restlessness, muscle tension, or feeling easily fatigued, that seem to go along with this constant worry?
Um... I don't really know. I guess I haven't really paid attention to that. I just... I mostly just notice the worrying.
Do you find yourself feeling restless, like you can't sit still, or do you notice any muscle tension, like your shoulders or neck feeling tight without a clear reason?
I mean... I guess I'm not really sure. Like I said, I haven't really noticed anything like that. Just the worrying, mostly.
Do you find it hard to focus or concentrate on tasks, or does your mind sometimes feel blank when you're feeling anxious?

Um... yeah, I guess. Sometimes at work... I'll be writing a script, or helping someone on a call—I do support in English and Spanish—and... I don't know, suddenly I'm just staring at the screen. My mind just drifts off to everything that could go wrong, and I... I just lose the thread.

Have you ever experienced sudden episodes where you felt intense fear or discomfort that came out of the blue, maybe with symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, shaking, or feeling like you couldn’t breathe?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really had anything like that happen.
Do you ever find yourself avoiding certain situations, tasks, or even people because you're worried about what might happen or how things might turn out?

I mean... I guess I do avoid some things. At work, I've been... falling behind on my tickets. I just end up double-checking the simple stuff so much that... well, my coworkers have had to pick up some of my slack. And... I don't know, outside of work, I've skipped a few dance nights recently. And some mentoring sessions I usually do. I just... I feel too overwhelmed to go, so I just stay home.
Do you find that your worries or avoidance are especially tied to situations where you feel like you might be judged or embarrassed, like speaking in front of others or performing during dance night?
Um... no, not really. It's not about people looking at me or... judging me. I just... I just don't feel up to it.
Have you gone through any stressful or traumatic events recently that you feel might be connected to how you’ve been feeling?
No... nothing like that. I haven't really had anything traumatic happen. Just... normal stuff, I guess.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these worries and feelings of being wound up been happening almost every day for several months or longer?
Yeah... pretty much every day. It's been... I don't know, about nine months? That's when... um, my condo loan started moving toward foreclosure. So... just since then.
Have these feelings of worry and being wound up made it hard for you to carry out your usual responsibilities at work, or caused you a lot of distress in your daily life?

Yeah... I guess it has. Work is... getting difficult. I've been falling behind on my support tickets. I just... I keep double-checking simple things, and it takes too long. Some of my coworkers have had to pick up the slack. 

And... outside of work, I've been skipping things. Like dance night... and my mentoring sessions. I just... I feel too overwhelmed to show up right now.
Do you find it hard to control or stop the worrying, even when you know the thoughts might not make sense or aren't likely to happen?

Yeah, I guess so. It's... hard to stop. Like, I'll tell myself I already checked the spreadsheet, or... or that I sent an email. But the thoughts just kind of... loop. And then one "what if" turns into, like, five more. I just... I can't really pull myself back from it easily.
Even when things are going smoothly in your life, like when there’s no immediate problem with your condo or work, do you still find yourself feeling anxious and worried about various things?

I mean... yeah, I guess so. It's... it's not just the condo anymore. Even if that's fine, I just... I find something else. Like... I'll worry if my cousin is mad at me about something. Or... I'll just sit there thinking about whether I'm going to mess up on a call at work. Or... just, you know, how I'm ever going to save money or... or do anything with my life. It just... it kind of jumps around.
Do you have trouble sleeping because your mind is too active or you're worrying, even when you're tired?

Yeah... sleep is hard. I'm usually really tired when I get in bed, but... my brain just won't shut off. I just lie there thinking about... work tickets, or those loan notices, or just... things I might have messed up. It usually takes until 2 or 3 in the morning to actually fall asleep. And then... even when I do sleep, I don't really feel rested when I wake up.
Have you noticed yourself feeling more irritable or easily annoyed lately, even over small things?
I don't know. I guess... maybe? I haven't really thought about it. I just... get stressed, I suppose.
Have you noticed yourself feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, like dance night or mentoring, even before all this worrying started?
No... not really. I mean, I still like going to dance night when I can. It's just... the worrying makes it hard to focus sometimes. But I don't think I've lost interest.

Have you ever had a sudden episode where your heart started racing, you felt short of breath, or you thought you might be having a heart attack or losing control, even when nothing dangerous was actually happening?
No, um... I don't think so. My heart doesn't really do that. I just... worry a lot. But no sudden attacks or anything like that.
Would you say that your excessive worry and anxiety are not limited to specific situations but happen across various areas of your life, and have occurred more days than not for at least six months?
Yeah... I suppose so. It's been... maybe nine months? Just... ever since the condo loan started moving toward foreclosure. It's just been going on since then.
